propositions: Bedrock inference-profile IDs must be probed for invokability in account 896586841071/us-east-1 before corpus spend, with bare calls and temperature=0 variants.
The parity corpus pools 30 stratified gold items across 15 specs (15 block, 15 advisory) to meet MIN_GOLD_ITEMS=20, excluding agentic ops that bypass resolve_gate_config.
Payload and tool parity must be proven by capturing outbound requests at the provider boundary, demonstrating identical system prompt, messages, and tool set across providers.
Provider routing must be provider-clean: zero non-Bedrock calls on the v2 arm, verified via REBAR_USAGE_LOG per-call model tallying.
Capability differences like temperature withdrawal on opus-4-8 must be explicit in the capability table and symmetric across providers, not silent divergences.
Structured-output validity, error rate, and latency are measured but informational under the rescoped criteria; LLM non-determinism (decision flips) is expected and out of scope for the parity bar.
